name: Coalition
_comment: Roster of the Long Range Tank mod. tier gates what a factory/engineer of that tier can build; built_by is the build category.

units.name: Commander
units.desc: Command mech. Builds the base. Lose it and you lose the battle.

units.name: Engineer
units.desc: Builds tier 1 structures, assists, repairs and reclaims.

units.name: Scavenger
units.desc: Cannot build. Reclaims wrecks, debris, trees and rocks, or revives wrecks as working units for your side (right-click a wreck, or J and drag a circle).

units.name: Tavria
units.desc: Armoured carrier. Takes six land units under armour (L load, K unload). Unarmed.

units.name: Buggy
units.desc: Land scout. Fast, fragile, long sight - the eyes of your guns.

units.name: Trooper
units.desc: Armored assault bot. Cheap plasma gun that also hurts armor.

units.name: AT Trooper
units.desc: Infantry with a guided anti-tank missile and three rounds of it; spent rounds come back one a minute for mass. Slow to reload; best fired from cover or from a building.

units.name: Sniper Trooper
units.desc: Marksman with a long rifle. Slow, accurate shots; also picks off infantry inside buildings from afar without harming the building.

units.name: SAM Trooper
units.desc: Infantry with a shoulder-fired homing anti-air missile and four rounds of it; spent rounds come back one a minute for mass. Aircraft only.

units.name: Overtaker M1
units.desc: Light tank. Quick flanker with a 75 mm gauss cannon.

units.name: Pike Mortar
units.desc: Mobile mortar. High-arc fire over hills, range 25-100. Slow traverse. Fires only standing and stays put 3 s after each shot.

units.name: MBFAG-113
units.desc: Mobile anti-air system. Rotary cannon bursts, long reach against aircraft.

units.name: Hailstorm
units.desc: Mobile flak on the Dragoon chassis. Bursts of airburst shells at aircraft out to 100; cannot shoot at the ground.

units.name: Skylance
units.desc: Mobile SAM on the Robin chassis. Its own T2 search radar (needs energy; finds stealth 1 aircraft) guides a heavy homing missile at aircraft out to 130, then it reloads for 10 s.

units.name: UC-01R Radar
units.desc: Mobile T1 radar: finds unstealthed units within 120. Hills block it. Needs energy.

units.name: UC-02R Radar
units.desc: Mobile T2 radar: finds unstealthed units within 180 and stealth 1 units (T2 aircraft) within 110. Hills block it. Costly to run.

units.name: UC-03R Radar
units.desc: Mobile T3 radar: finds unstealthed units within 260, stealth 1 units within 180 and stealth 2 units (T3 aircraft) within 100. Infantry never show on radar. Hills block it. Very costly to run.

units.name: Crony M1
units.desc: Main battle tank. Slow turret, heavy armor, 200 damage at range 80.

units.name: Dragoon ARV
units.desc: Armored recon vehicle. Very fast, long sight, 7-round autocannon bursts.

units.name: Robin
units.desc: Mobile anti-tank. One guided missile every 30 seconds; it kills most tanks.

units.name: Sparky
units.desc: Field engineer. Builds up to tier 2 and, alone, field works: sandbags, trenches, bunkers and watch towers. Carries a riot gun and a short-range radar.

units.name: Engineer Mk2
units.desc: Builds tier 1-2 structures.

units.name: Bohdana
units.desc: Self-propelled howitzer. Range 60-300. Slow to aim, useless without spotters. Fires only standing and stays put 5 s after each shot.

units.name: Bastion
units.desc: Heavy tank with explosive reactive armor: its first four missile hits (AT troopers, Robins) lose three quarters of their damage, and a full repair replaces the tiles. 320 damage at range 90, slow turret.

units.name: Engineer Mk3
units.desc: Builds every structure.

units.name: Kestrel
units.desc: Air scout. Huge sight radius, unarmed.

units.name: Porter
units.desc: Interceptor. Fixed forward railguns, air targets only.

units.name: Cyclone
units.desc: Heavy air superiority fighter. Railguns for aircraft only. Stealth 2, and its own T3 fire-control radar finds stealthed aircraft within 80 (needs energy).

units.name: Firebrand
units.desc: Attack bomber. Runs over its target, drops a stick of five bombs across it, flies on and comes round for the next pass.

units.name: Harrier FB
units.desc: Fighter-bomber. Fast; railguns for aircraft and a pair of bombs for ground targets.

units.name: Hornet
units.desc: Gunship. Hovers and rakes ground units with riot gun bursts, infantry first.

units.name: Stork
units.desc: Transport aircraft. Lifts eight land units over cliffs and water (L load, K unload). Unarmed.

units.name: Swift
units.desc: Fast assault transport for aggressive airdrops: twice as fast as the Stork, carries eight land units like it (L load, K unload). Stealth 1: only T2+ radar finds it. Unarmed.

units.name: Delivery Boy
units.desc: Prototype heavy bomber. One enormous bomb, armored airframe.

units.name: Mass Pump
units.desc: Extracts mass from a deposit. Upgradeable (U).

units.name: Mass Pump Mk2
units.desc: Triple output, more upkeep. Built by tier 2+ engineers or upgraded from a Mass Pump (U).

units.name: Mass Pump Mk3
units.desc: Maximum extraction, heavy energy upkeep. Built by tier 3 engineers or upgraded from a Mk2 pump.

units.name: Windmill
units.desc: Cheap power: +20 energy.

units.name: Power Plant
units.desc: Reliable power: +120 energy. Explodes when destroyed.

units.name: Solar Field
units.desc: Massive power: +400 energy.

units.name: Energy Storage
units.desc: Stores 5000 energy. Explodes violently.

units.name: Mass Storage
units.desc: Stores 500 mass.

units.name: Land Factory
units.desc: Builds tier 1 land units. Upgrade (U) for higher tiers.

units.name: Land Factory Mk2
units.desc: Builds tier 1-2 land units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: Land Factory Mk3
units.desc: Builds tier 1-3 land units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: Air Factory
units.desc: Builds tier 1 air units. Upgrade (U) for higher tiers.

units.name: Air Factory Mk2
units.desc: Builds tier 1-2 air units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: Air Factory Mk3
units.desc: Builds tier 1-3 air units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: HMG Turret
units.desc: Point defense. Shreds bots and scouts, bounces off armor.

units.name: Gauss Turret
units.desc: Anti-armor emplacement. High-arc fire, range 30-90, very slow traverse.

units.name: Dart Railgun
units.desc: Anti-air turret.

units.name: Faust SAM
units.desc: Long-range SAM site. Its own T2 search radar (needs energy; finds stealth 1 aircraft) guides one heavy homing missile at an aircraft, then it reloads for 25 s.

units.name: Phalanx Railgun Battery
units.desc: Heavy anti-air battery: twin long railguns guided by its own T3 radar (finds stealth 2 aircraft within 120; needs energy).

units.name: Radar Tower
units.desc: T1 radar: finds unstealthed units within 160. Blocked by terrain - build it on high ground. Needs energy. Upgradeable (U).

units.name: Radar Tower Mk2
units.desc: T2 radar: finds unstealthed units within 250 and stealth 1 units (T2 aircraft) within 160. Blocked by terrain. Costly to run. Built by tier 2+ engineers or upgraded from a Radar Tower (U).

units.name: Radar Tower Mk3
units.desc: T3 radar: finds unstealthed units within 360, stealth 1 units within 250 and stealth 2 units (T3 aircraft) within 150. Infantry never show on radar. Blocked by terrain. Very costly to run. Built by tier 3 engineers or upgraded from a Radar Tower Mk2 (U).

units.name: Engineering Station
units.desc: Automatically assists every construction, upgrade and repair within its radius.

units.name: Bertha Heavy Battery
units.desc: Fortified 120 mm gun. Range 40-200, big blast, traverses at a crawl.

units.name: Sandbags
units.desc: A stretch of sandbag wall; drag to build a line. Enemy shots that fly through it lose half their damage to it, until it is shot or bombed to pieces. Infantry take cover behind it. Units can cross it.

units.name: Trench
units.desc: A piece of trench; drag to build a line. The ground is dug out and stays dug when the trench is destroyed. Infantry standing in it lose only part of every hit and blast to it - the rest goes into the trench, which gives way in time.

units.name: Field Bunker
units.desc: Concrete bunker for up to 4 infantry, who fire from it and take only a small share of the hits on it.

units.name: Watch Tower
units.desc: Tall lookout for up to 2 infantry: from its platform they see and use their binoculars 1.6 times as far, over trees and low hills, and fire from up there.
